---
title: "Two experiments on a virtual pet"
---

Two case studies from the same simulated virtual pet, each told as question, design, data, result and what I would do differently. Every official number is recomputed from the published data.

1. **[Does reward keep a virtual pet awake?](notebooks/02_case_study.ipynb)** A pre-registered simulation experiment with 9,600 lives, and the bug that hit the analysis after the lives were saved. ([Resumo em português](resumo-pt.qmd))
2. **[The effect that shrank](notebooks/04_body_triage_case_study.ipynb)** The same body change, re-measured on the current version of the pet: a 20-unit triage with no formal reading, next to the earlier, larger estimate, and the decision not to run the confirmatory study. ([Resumo em português](resumo-pt-corpo.qmd))
